faq.q: What is the average temperature in Marbella in November 2029?
faq.a: Average daytime highs reach 20°C (68°F) and lows around 14°C (57°F). Sea temperature is about 17°C, so swimming is possible but brisk. Pack a light jacket for evenings.

faq.q: Is November a good time for a boat rental in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, November offers mild weather, fewer crowds, and lower prices on premium boats like the Mangusta 80. You'll enjoy calm seas and clear views of the Costa del Sol coastline.

faq.q: How many hours of sunshine can I expect in November?
faq.a: Expect around 7 hours of sunshine per day, typically from late morning to mid-afternoon. Sunrise is around 07:45 and sunset about 18:15, so plan your charter accordingly.

faq.q: What should I wear for a boat trip in November?
faq.a: Layers are key: a light jumper or fleece, a windproof jacket, and comfortable trousers. Bring sunglasses, sunscreen, and a hat for sunny spells. Non-slip shoes are recommended.

faq.q: Are there any weather risks for boating in November?
faq.a: November is generally calm, but occasional Atlantic fronts can bring short rain showers or stronger winds. We monitor forecasts closely and may suggest rescheduling if conditions are unsafe.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a November charter?
faq.a: Flybridge yachts like the Azimut 58 offer sheltered indoor saloons with panoramic views. The Mangusta 80 is also excellent with a spacious main deck and heating options.

faq.q: Can I swim or use water toys in November?
faq.a: Swimming is possible but the water is cool (17°C). Some guests enjoy a quick dip. Jet skis and paddleboards are available on request, though wetsuits are advisable.

faq.a: Visit our [Marbella boat rental](/blog/marbella-boat-rental-weather-november-2029-guide/) page or contact us via WhatsApp. Early booking secures your preferred vessel and date.

data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental weather November 2029? You’re in for a treat: mild temperatures around 18°C, calm seas, and fewer crowds make this a smart choice for a late-season cruise. While summer heat fades, November offers clear skies, 7 hours of daily sunshine, and excellent availability on premium yachts from Puerto Banús. Whether you’re celebrating a birthday or simply escaping the northern chill, this guide covers everything you need—from average temps to boat recommendations.

November Weather Overview for Marbella

Marbella enjoys a Mediterranean climate, and November is one of the most pleasant months for boating. Average highs reach 20°C, with lows around 14°C. Sea temperature sits at 17°C—cooler than August but still swimmable for the brave. Rainfall is minimal: typically 5-6 days of light showers, often overnight. Winds average 5-12 knots, creating gentle swells ideal for a smooth ride. Sunset at 18:15 means you can enjoy a full half-day or even a sunset cruise without the summer rush.

Best Boats for November Charters

With lower demand, you can snag premium vessels at competitive rates. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is a top pick: its enclosed saloon and flybridge offer protection from any breeze, and the €4,719 minimum 4-hour charter includes a free jet ski. For a more intimate trip, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) provides a heated interior and panoramic windows. Smaller groups might prefer the Fairline Targa 12m (10 pax) for its sporty yet comfortable layout. All charters depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance.

Typical November Itineraries

A half-day (4 hours) lets you cruise from Puerto Banús to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, where you can anchor for a light swim or enjoy snacks on deck. A full-day (8 hours) extends to Estepona or even Sotogrande, with lunch at a beachfront chiringuito. Since sunset is early, a 14:00-18:00 slot is perfect for a golden-hour sail. The Azimut 39 (€749/2h or €2,299/8h) is a budget-friendly option for a quick escape.

What to Pack for a November Boat Trip

Layering is essential. Bring a fleece or light sweater, a windproof jacket, and long trousers. Non-slip shoes are recommended for deck safety. Don’t forget sunscreen (UV still strong), sunglasses, and a hat. If you plan to swim, a wetsuit or rash guard will make the 17°C water more enjoyable. Our charters provide soft drinks, beer, wine, cava, and light snacks, but you’re welcome to bring extra food.

Booking Tips for November 2029

Book early to secure your preferred boat, especially for weekends. November is popular for corporate events and small celebrations. Use WhatsApp for pricing on boats like the Ferretti 94 or Canados 86. Check our Marbella boat rental guide for more details. All bookings include Spanish IVA (21%)—no hidden fees.

Frequently asked questions

What is the average temperature in Marbella in November 2029?

Average daytime highs reach 20°C (68°F) and lows around 14°C (57°F). Sea temperature is about 17°C, so swimming is possible but brisk. Pack a light jacket for evenings.

Is November a good time for a boat rental in Marbella?

Yes, November offers mild weather, fewer crowds, and lower prices on premium boats like the Mangusta 80. You'll enjoy calm seas and clear views of the Costa del Sol coastline.

Expect around 7 hours of sunshine per day, typically from late morning to mid-afternoon. Sunrise is around 07:45 and sunset about 18:15, so plan your charter accordingly.

What should I wear for a boat trip in November?

Layers are key: a light jumper or fleece, a windproof jacket, and comfortable trousers. Bring sunglasses, sunscreen, and a hat for sunny spells. Non-slip shoes are recommended.

Are there any weather risks for boating in November?

November is generally calm, but occasional Atlantic fronts can bring short rain showers or stronger winds. We monitor forecasts closely and may suggest rescheduling if conditions are unsafe.

Flybridge yachts like the Azimut 58 offer sheltered indoor saloons with panoramic views. The Mangusta 80 is also excellent with a spacious main deck and heating options.
